blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture Region VII (DA-7) recorded download speeds of 823.26 megabits per second after being connected to the government’s dedicated network through the Department of Information and Communications Technology Region VII (DICT-7). DICT-7 launched the Government Network (GovNet) connection at the DA-7 compound in Cebu City on Monday, Sept. 14, as part of the nationwide “Handog ng Pangulo” caravan. A live speed test also recorded an upload speed of 945.77 Mbps. “The initiative marks a significant milestone in upgrading the agency’s digital infrastructure to foster faster, more efficient public service delivery,” the DICT said in a […]...
